strings.(짙은 어둠만이 가득한 크노소스의 밤, 하늘을 바라보고 있던 탈로스가 미: (On a night shrouded in darkness in Knossos, Talos frowns as he looks up at the sky.)
strings.크노소스가 뭐라고 이렇게 관심들이 많아. 여신의 사람이 오질 않나, 마족: What is it about Knossos that attracts so much attention? First the goddess' follower, then a demon. And now...
...Even the Talos I crushed has come back.
strings.탈로스, 난 네가 깨어난 이유를 알고 있다. 하지만, 다시는 그러지 않았: Talos, I know why you woke. But I would prefer you never did that again...
You haven't shown yourself for so long. If you've come now...
Yes, that's right. I've come to speak with your younger brother.
strings.(어둠 속에서 커다란 지팡이가 뻗어 나와 탈로스의 어깨를 두드린다.): (A large staff reaches out of the darkness and taps Talos on the shoulder.)
strings.허튼 수에 내가 당할 내가 아니다. 이 힘은…. 윽…. 뭐야…?: I won't fall for some cheap trick. This power... Ngh... What is it...?
strings.당장 다가올 밤의 일부, 이스트랜드의 죄인이 깨우친 힘…. '속박'입니다: A piece of the night soon to come. The power mastered by the sinner of Eastland... 'Binding.'
strings.(다프네라고 불린 여성이 환하게 웃으며 지팡이를 거둔다. 그리고 키가 큰: (The woman called Daphne smiles brightly and withdraws her staff. As she looks up at the towering Talos, her unusually long ears twitch.)
strings.탈로스와 대화하고 싶군요. 미노스 님이 제 기척을 느끼고 분노를 터뜨리기: I wish to speak with Talos. Before Lord Minos senses my presence and flies into a rage.
strings.(탈로스가 고개를 숙이고 다시 눈을 뜨자 다프네가 조용히 그의 이름을 부: (Talos lowers his head. When he opens his eyes again, Daphne quietly calls his name.)
strings.하나만 물을게요. 당신이 파시파에와 미노스 님을 깨웠나요?: One question. Did you awaken Pasiphae and Lord Minos?
strings.네, 그래야 할 것 같았으니까요. 하지만, 형님이 또 수를 써서 그분들을: Yes. I felt I should. But my brother interfered again, and I couldn't get them out.
I couldn't bring back the golem.
That is all right. Thanks to you, that child was able to come here as well.
strings.이스트랜드의 죄인, 그 자가 하려는 일은 어떻게 될까요? 다프네 님이 기: What will become of the sinner of Eastland's plans? What effect will they have on the night you await, Lady Daphne...?
strings.글쎄요, 후후. 일단 기다려보는 건 어떨까요? 어차피 밤은 하나도 아니고: Who can say? Hehe. Why don't we wait and see? There is more than one night, and nights are long...
Talos, you must be tired. Rest for a while.
strings.(다프네가 지팡이를 뻗어 탈로스의 어깨를 두드리자, 탈로스가 그대로 정신: (Daphne extends her staff and taps Talos on the shoulder. He immediately loses consciousness and falls to the ground.)
(After checking on the fallen Talos, Daphne quietly turns her gaze to the night sky.)
strings.당신 뜻대로 당신이 보낸 죄인을 도왔습니다. 하지만, 그 선택이 크노소스: I helped the sinner you sent, as you wished. But I never knew that choice would tighten a noose around Knossos and our people.
So now I will act as I wish.
Though the night that awaits us rests in the hands of the one who accompanies the goddess destined to face the sinner...
strings.그래서 당신, 절 기다리고 있었나요?: And you. Were you waiting for me?
Um... Thank you for saving me...
strings.그런 걸 가지고 뭘요. 당신은 멍청하게 열쇠가 될뻔 했어요. 덕분에 데이: Think nothing of it. You almost foolishly became a key. Deimos nearly arrived sooner than expected because of you... But it is all right.
strings.그러니까 당신은 하던 대로 도망쳐요. 그리고 발버둥 치세요. 그래야 재미: So keep running, as you have been. Keep struggling. That will make it entertaining...
strings.물론이죠. 당신도, 나도, 그들도 모두 같은 부류니까…. 그래도 지금 저: Of course. You, I, and they are all the same kind... But I don't want it from you just yet.
strings.언젠가 붙잡힐 그 밤을 기다리면서 도망쳐요…. 부디!! 내 즐거움을 위해: Run, and wait for the night you are finally caught... Please! For my amusement!!
